description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Management for the Safe Operation of Ships) Regulations No. 9 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, establishing new legal requirements for ship safety management.
